VENDORED DEPENDENCIES AND PROVENANCE

vendor/bdcl_v29 contains 17 active MATLAB files supporting robot geometry and
rigid-body dynamics, position-servo and electrical-power models, configuration,
and position-command/feedback serialization. ACTIVE_MANIFEST.csv lists these
retained files by project-relative path and SHA256.

UPSTREAM_MANIFEST.csv preserves the original 204-entry import inventory and
hashes. It is provenance for the source import, not a list of files present in
the current vendor directory. Reproduction of a packaged study should use that
study's source snapshot and manifest so that its recorded source identity is
preserved.

Existing function names, protocol fields and data formats are retained for
compatibility with dependencies and frozen models. In particular, bdclp in the
feedback request is part of the existing extension protocol. It does not imply
that stock firmware implements the requested compact-v2 telemetry.

The nominal RoArm-M2-S rigid-body parameters in
bdcl_v29/private/spinn3d_roarm_m2s_nominal_params.m credit Waveshare's public
RoArm-M2-S URDF. Geometry and source assumptions remain documented in that file.
The command/feedback interface records Waveshare firmware and SDK source URLs
and reference commits in bdcl_v29/bdclp_interface_defaults.m. Preserve those
source attributions and the original headers when reusing these files.
